changes.en: Clean up can delete any file it lists: for each one it says plainly what the file is, what deleting it does and what is better, and files that are risky to delete need a tick on "I understand what happens" first. Core Windows files (the Windows folder, page and hibernation files, System Volume Information, $ folders) are no longer listed at all
changes.zh: 空间清理现在可以删除列出的任何文件：每个文件都会用大白话说明它是什么、删除后会怎样、有什么更好的做法；删除有风险的文件前需要先勾选“我了解删除后的结果”。Windows 核心文件（Windows 文件夹、页面文件和休眠文件、System Volume Information、以 $ 开头的文件夹）不再列出

changes.en: Space map: every folder is a block sized by its space, split into its biggest subfolders; click a block to jump to it in the list below (a deeper block opens its folder first)
changes.zh: 空间分布图：每个文件夹是一个方块，面积代表占用空间，并细分为它最大的子文件夹；点击方块即可跳到下方列表中的对应项（更深一层的方块会先打开所在文件夹）

changes.en: Reading a drive is about twice as fast: folders are handed to whichever worker is free, and a big folder is split among all of them instead of keeping one worker busy alone (on the test PC 71.5 s → 35.5 s for 1.86 million files)
changes.zh: 读取磁盘速度约提高一倍：文件夹交给空闲的工作进程处理，大文件夹会分给所有工作进程，不再由一个进程独自读完（测试电脑上 186 万个文件从 71.5 秒降到 35.5 秒）

changes.en: Against deleting the wrong thing (Gemini review): every deletion shows what it means first; recovery copies and unsaved drafts, databases anywhere (with their -wal / -shm journals) and files changed in the last 24 hours need the tick; Windows' machine keys, activation, credential vault and Defender data, bootsect.bak, boottel.dat and MSOCache are core and not listed; program files offer Windows' uninstall; tiny space-map slivers are merged and blocks say what a click does
changes.zh: 防止误删（Gemini 评审）：每次删除前都先说明后果；恢复副本和未保存的草稿、任何位置的数据库（含 -wal / -shm 日志）以及 24 小时内修改过的文件需要勾选确认；Windows 的机器密钥、激活凭据、凭据保险库和 Defender 数据，以及 bootsect.bak、boottel.dat、MSOCache 视为核心文件，不再列出；程序文件提供“打开 Windows 卸载”；空间分布图合并过小的碎片方块，并提示点击后的行为

changes.en: Finer kinds of file against deleting the wrong thing: browser profiles (passwords, bookmarks) apart from browser caches, WSL and Docker virtual disks, iPhone backups, game saves, app databases, logs, crash dumps and package caches each get their own explanation
changes.zh: 更细的文件分类，避免误删：浏览器配置文件（密码、书签）与浏览器缓存分开，WSL 和 Docker 虚拟磁盘、iPhone 备份、游戏存档、软件数据库、日志、崩溃转储和软件包缓存都有各自的说明

changes.en: Plain labels instead of "Uninstall instead": Program file, Synced to the cloud, App data, App settings or cache, Your file, Can be deleted
changes.zh: 标签改为直白的说法，不再显示“请改为卸载”：程序文件、云同步文件、应用数据、软件设置或缓存、你的文件、可以删除
